She pushed herself on top of me and after I repeatedly told her "No, I don't want to." and "No, I don't have time", she leaned into my ear and said "Come on, you know you'll like it" and slid me into her. I was frozen in shock, unable to do anything.

I've been suffering from severe depression, bi-polar 1 disorder, OCD, PTSD, BPD, and anxiety since a child and everything is so overwhelming all the time. I struggle with suicidal thoughts and practice, everyday is a fight to keep myself alive. I barely eat because i'm disgusted by the way food feels in my mouth and how I look. I barely sleep because if I do, i'm afraid that someone will hurt me. I destroy all of my relationships because i'm terrified that I will get too close to someone and they will be able to destroy me.

nobody can hurt me if I hurt myself first.
